summary: Υ_j is a named indicator of (1; 0) mod 𝔪; the pair Weil action moves the indicator of y to that of k̄′yk̄⁻¹ times character values at the determinants, and k̄′(1; 0)k̄⁻¹ = (1; 0) by h.

steps.claim: Substitute g, g′ and write Υ_j as the datum of the indicator of (1; 0) modulo 𝔪 on the vacuum.

The pair Weil action of (k, k′) on the datum of the indicator of a single residue matrix y gives the datum of the indicator of k̄′·y·k̄⁻¹ times the values of the two characters at det k, det k′ (pairWeil_modDatum_single); it remains that k̄′(1; 0)k̄⁻¹ = (1; 0) modulo 𝔪, checked place by place.

The character values: rankTwist(D.chainChar(ϑ, j+1)) has weight with tame part liftTame(ϑ, j) (hasWeight_liftChar), so its value at det k for k ∈ K₀ is the product of the tame parts at the places of 𝔪 (apply_det_eq_prod), giving the stated quotient.
At each place x, rewrite the inverse of g_x.
Then the identity at x is h at x.
